test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in direct speech.

His angry mother jeered and asked whether he supposed that he knew better than his own father.

options.text: “Do you suppose you know better than your own father?” jeered his angry mother.
Her mother jeeringly expressed , “He doesn’t know better than his own father.”
Her mother supposed, “‘He knew better than his own father.”
“Do you know better than your father I suppose” jeered his angry mother.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** His angry mother jeered and asked whether he supposed that he knew better than his own father.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"whether he supposed that he knew" becomes "Do you suppose you know"**
 
 
• Indirect question "whether he supposed" is converted to direct question "Do you suppose."
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "you" to match di
